svg.title: Plotter — motion and growth
svg.desc: Newton’s cradle and a branching leaf, drawn with shared construction lines, measured proportions, and transparent forms.

svg.title: Newton’s cradle, at release
svg.desc: Five equal pendulums share a tangent rest position; one follows a true arc from a 30° release.

svg.title: A branching leaf
svg.desc: Paired veins follow a repeated pitch within a leaf formed by two intersecting arcs.
